parsed.why: No criminalisation, documented acceptance and protections in force; hate-crime rise and LGBT-wide violence are notable but not trans-specific; care access strain is resident-facing. Reduced-to-low band, held below top for hostility data and unresolved gender-marker/border questions.

Declaration-based recognition, gender-identity discrimination ban and aggravating hate-crime factor; prison placement is case-by-case with no birth-sex rule. Border/facility questions unanswered and no trans-specific violence data, keeping it just below Dossier 1.
Criminalises same-sex conduct reaching trans presentation, documented raids and armed-group executions, no recognition or protection, and a trans visitor has no complaint route. Severe band.

No criminal exposure for trans identity and no recognition route, but no anti-discrimination protection, documented hate-speech enforcement is for sexual orientation only, and strongly conservative society. Elevated band; thin trans-specific record.

Criminalises same-sex conduct and advocacy, documented cross-dressing arrests, police coercion of a trans person, custody and care denial, and documented impunity. State enforcement against gender-nonconforming people dominates. Severe band.
